# dsh-purge adaptation notice

This project adapts request-time prompt composition and runtime-context continuity concepts from [YuJunZhiXue/dsh-purge](https://github.com/YuJunZhiXue/dsh-purge), version 1.1.71 at commit [`6c1d638d1bdcc45ede50fc30249c753d58122a51`](https://github.com/YuJunZhiXue/dsh-purge/tree/6c1d638d1bdcc45ede50fc30249c753d58122a51).

The upstream repository declares the MIT License. Its license notice is preserved in [LICENSE](LICENSE). The API adapter is an original compatibility text; no upstream JavaScript, YAML patches, or system-prompt passages are copied. This adaptation uses the request's actual messages and tools and does not attempt to reproduce DeepSeek Harness package patches, desktop hooks, UI, local permission changes, or refusal-bypass text.
